name: Errand for Apothecary Zinge

narrative.details:
The Royal Apothecary Society needs your assistance.  Listen closely, and both of us may profit from my plan.

Apothecary Keever in the next room may be... touched... but his research does potentially bear fruit if it were pursued by a clever researcher.  Fortunately, I am such a researcher.  I want you to take this purchase order to Alessandro Luca, the proprietor of Blue Moon Odds and Ends; he'll give you a testing kit.  When you have it, bring it back to me and I'll outline your task in detail.
narrative.objectives: Take the purchase order to Alessandro Luca in the Undercity.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Ah, Zinge needs a kit, does she?  It saddens me that Zinge does not choose to grace myself with her sweet presence.

Very well, let me procure a kit for you.
narrative.requestItemsText: Yes, and what may I assist you with?  Are you here on business for the Royal Apothecary Society, or have you arrived here merely to brighten my day?

chain.subtitle: 7 quests from level 45 to 46, 14,930 XP in all.

quests.name: Errand for Apothecary Zinge
quests.objectiveText: Take the purchase order to Alessandro Luca in the Undercity.

quests.name: Errand for Apothecary Zinge
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Field Sampling Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.

quests.name: Into the Field
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan about getting a power source for the testing kit.

quests.name: Slake That Thirst
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan.

quests.name: Tanaris Field Sampling
quests.objectiveText: Acquire acceptable samples for 8 basilisks, 8 hyenas, and 8 scorpions.

quests.name: Another Power Source?
quests.objectiveText: Bring 10 Wastewander Water Pouches to Chief Engineer Bilgewhizzle in Gadgetzan in exchange for another power source.

quests.name: Return to Apothecary Zinge
quests.objectiveText: Bring the Sealed Field Testing Kit to Apothecary Zinge in the Undercity.
